name: PrimateAI-3D
licence: Illumina academic/non-commercial, registration required — verify on fetch
ships: fetch script + digest, never the score file
notes:
Structure-aware missense lane, the closest independent rival to AlphaMissense. The download
is behind an Illumina BaseSpace registration page rather than a plain URL, so `--fetch` will
not work unattended — a human accepts the terms and drops the file in
`build/it4/tables/primateai3d/`; the script then digests and converts it. Verify on fetch.
